title: wildcardPattern
summary: Create a pattern matching arbitrary text.

gpu_support.notes: The returned pattern is host metadata. Automatically resident numeric count controls gather transparently; explicit gpuArray count controls are unsupported.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `wildcardPattern` creates a lazy pattern that matches as few characters as possible, including zero by default, or an exact or inclusive bounded count.

inputs.name: N
inputs.description: Exact nonnegative number of characters to match.

inputs.name: maxCharacters
inputs.description: Inclusive nonnegative maximum, or positive infinity.

behaviors: Without a count, the lazy pattern can match zero characters and therefore prefers an empty match when unconstrained.
Exact and bounded counts accept single, double, and all eight integer classes without routing typed values through floating compatibility storage.
The bounded form accepts positive infinity as the maximum and stays lazy toward the minimum bound.
